definitions.supplemental: Laym. frum first: Goth. fruma the first: Icel. frum- the first: Lat. prīmus the first.

quotations.old_english: Frum, in composition, is used with the preceding meanings

source_text: FRUM; def. se fruma; adj. Original, primitive, first; n&a-long;t&i-long;vus, pr&i-long;m&i-short;t&i-long;vus, pr&i-long;mus :-- Frum, in composition, is used with the preceding meanings :-- On ðære fruman gecynde in the original nature, Bt. 30, 2; Fox 110, 14. Ðone fruman sceaft geþencan to remember the first creation, Bt. 30, 2; Fox 110, 17, 21. Fr&u-long;mes primæ, Rtl. 35, 13. Æt fruman at first [cf. æt ǽrestan], H. R. 103, 34. [Laym. frum first: Goth. fruma the first: Icel. frum- the first: Lat. pr&i-long;mus the first.]
